## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Change category

- [ ] HTML structure or semantics
- [ ] CSS or responsive layout
- [ ] Accessibility
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Asset cleanup or licensing
- [ ] Repository maintenance
- [ ] Other

## Validation

- [ ] Tested locally using a static server.
- [ ] Checked phone, tablet, and desktop widths.
- [ ] Checked keyboard navigation and visible focus.
- [ ] Checked browser console and network requests.
- [ ] Verified all local asset and documentation links.
- [ ] Confirmed no credentials, private data, or unlicensed media were added.

## Scope check

- [ ] README and documentation describe actual behavior, not planned functionality.
- [ ] No real booking, payment, authentication, or availability functionality is implied.
